Novelty_1_Physiological_Acceleration.classification: B. PROMISING BUT NOT YET PROVEN
Novelty_1_Physiological_Acceleration.justification: Modest AUROC gain (+0.0012) on test set. Requires prospective validation.

Novelty_2_Organ_Dysfunction_Matrix.classification: B. PROMISING BUT NOT YET PROVEN
Novelty_2_Organ_Dysfunction_Matrix.justification: Useful for clinical sub-scoring, but marginal impact on overall discrimination.

Novelty_3_Temperature_Scaling.justification: Monotonic transformation does not alter ROC AUC. Improves calibration Brier score only.

Novelty_4_Vasopressor_MAP_Adjustment.justification: Uses Shock Index proxy and manual coefficient 5.0 rather than true MAR vasopressor dose data.

Novelty_5_LOS_Adaptive_Persistence.classification: B. PROMISING BUT NOT YET PROVEN
Novelty_5_LOS_Adaptive_Persistence.justification: Improves early stay sensitivity, but increases early screening false alerts by +14.2%.

Novelty_6_Dual_Tier_Architecture.justification: Decoupling screening (high sensitivity) from confirmation (high PPV) is mathematically sound and clinically defensible.
